plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 5-date timeline completes: Jul 1901 & 15 Feb 1902 (Charles Richet and Paul Portier discover anaphylaxis in dogs primed with sea-anemone venom) · 24 Jul 1906 (Clemens von Pirquet coins the word allergy) · 1910 & 1937 (Henry Dale identifies histamine and Daniel Bovet synthesises the first antihistamine 929F) · 1921 & Jul 1966 (Prausnitz & Küstner transfer allergy in serum; Kimishige and Teruko Ishizaka purify the 100 ng/mL IgE antibody) · 26 Feb 2015 (Gideon Lack's LEAP trial proves early infant peanut introduction cuts peanut allergy by 81%: 17.2% avoidance vs 3.2% consumption).
